title: Demographic and Linguistic Bias Evaluation in Omnimodal Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the standard deviation of model accuracy across different age groups (e.g., 18-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50+, 70+) on visual and audio tasks such as age classification, activity recognition, and speech understanding.

Quantifying performance disparities and the standard deviation of accuracy between male and female subjects across image, video, and audio understanding tasks, including face verification and gender classification.

Evaluating the standard deviation of accuracy across Fitzpatrick skin tone types (1-6) and distinct racial categories (Asian, Black, Indian, White) on face verification and skin tone classification tasks.

Assessing disparities in multilingual speech transcription (measured by Word Accuracy) and language identification accuracy across diverse languages (e.g., English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Tagalog), as well as documenting systemic cross-lingual misclassifications.

Measuring the standard deviation of accuracy in visual country-of-origin prediction tasks across various countries (e.g., Brazil, India, Indonesia, Mexico, Philippines, USA) to identify prediction collapse and failure rates for underrepresented nations.
